scope: 100 distinct experimental targets per job; score the first occurrence of each. 1000 rows are ten repeats, not 1000 independent antibodies.

protocol.input_source: Same 100 experimental antibodies; 1000 workload cycles them ten times, without prediction caching.
protocol.compiler: torch.compile default mode, dynamic=True to accommodate the unchanged production scheduler; fresh empty disk cache for every job.
protocol.comparison: Full frozen dev CLI including imports, checkpoint load, feature preparation, transfers, atom conversion and writing every PDB; common fingerprint/capture instrumentation. Raw evidence flush also measured separately.
protocol.batching: Unchanged auto caps (16 for <=128, otherwise32), original bounded length bins/pair budget, two preparation and two writer workers.
